description: In front of you there’s a wicker basket of assorted food on a red cloth and, to the right, a light-colored plate holding a red apple, a green pepper-shaped item, and two dark olives. The left hand moves in from the lower right toward the basket, grasps a small sugar-dusted bread roll as a left-hand object, lifts it up and over to the right, then lowers and releases it onto the plate beside the apple, leaving the hand resting near the plate edge.
